chosen.title: woman with a backpack walking up the stairs
chosen.why: Solo figure seen from behind climbing worn stone steps out of a dim covered passage toward a bright arched opening above; warm low-saturation stone tones, steady handheld follow, quiet and unhurried. Not a subway but reads clearly as underground-to-daylight stairs, matching the tone better than any actual metro clip found. Backpack shows only a small blank leather tag, no legible text.

alternates.why: Most literal match: crowd climbing real subway exit stairs toward daylight, backs to camera, muted film-like grade. But dense midday crowd, some colorful shirts and occasional side profiles; busier than the quiet-morning tone.
Feet-only shot of boots riding an escalator upward, neutral gray with warm leather, no faces, clean. Lacks the light-from-above and exit context, motion is subtle.

notes: Searched: subway stairs, subway entrance, metro exit stairs, people leaving subway, escalator, stairs, walking up stairs. Mixkit has very few true subway-exit clips: 4372 is a night-time long-exposure timelapse (blurred ghosting, night lights) and 4154 is a fast daytime timelapse; both too frantic/stocky. 27463 (boy on escalator) has a saturated green jacket. Chosen clip is landscape 1280x720 at 25fps; in_point 1.0 + 2.7 + 0.2 = 3.9s <= 17.84s. Any window 0-10s works if a different position on the stairs is preferred (figure gets smaller and arch light dominates later).
